item.title: Fox News Parts Ways with Maria Bartiromo
item.description: Fox News Media dismissed longtime host Maria Bartiromo for business reasons, a spokesperson confirmed to Axios on Thursday.

item.title: Rep. Analilia Mejia launches super PAC to back progressive candidates
item.description: After her upset primary win against better-funded establishment opponents, Rep. Analilia Mejia (D-N.J.) is starting a super PAC to support similar progressive campaigns.

item.title: Trump administration drafting post-war Middle East plan
item.description: The Trump administration is developing a post-war strategy focused on containing Iran and expanding normalization agreements in the region.

item.title: Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner to visit Moscow and Kyiv this weekend
item.description: U.S. officials say Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will travel to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend for talks on ending the war.
